attBesluta.text: Good quality teeth for my tractor bucket. It was easy to install. Just have to drill a number of holes in the bucket and install heady duty nuts and bolts ( included). The teeth seem really heavy duty iron, and are welded to the bar.

Seems very heavy duty I think it will last. Shipping was excellent. The only thing you better have a hell of a bit to drill through your bucket to attach it permanently it also clamps on but didn’t hold for any heavy duty work

I bought this for my Kioti tractor bucket. I was a little skeptical at first as the price was much lower than comparable tooth bars. I have to say this is much nicer than I expected. The bar is quite heavy and the teeth are beefy. My one complaint is that the bolt on holes wont work for my bucket, they line up directly in line with where the cutting edge of my bucket is welded to the body, so it ‹NAMN› be difficult to drill holes in that location. I have used it with the clamp on set screws without issue, might be able to make a slight modification to use the clamp on set screw holes to bolt through. But I haven't looked too far into yet. Overall very nice tooth bar for the price, I am thoroughly impressed, ‹NAMN› 100% ‹NAMN› ‹NAMN›.
Fantastic seat very comfortable was hard to install but that was cuz my usecase was definitely not intended for this seat
Seat is good quality, but could have more bolt patterns to make it more universal. I needed to make a different set of brackets to attach to my older Kubota.

Excellent ladder for the price. The ladder works well and is pretty stable for a long attic ladder. The only issues I had in installation were that the long threaded grip inserts didn't grab the rafter as well as they should have. I drilled and added a couple additional lag screws just to be sure. Also some of the ladder screws themselves loosen over time (I use it a lot) and need occasional checks and retightening. Overall I'm quite happy with it.
Mit Lieferung war alles OK, nun kann man nicht Einbau wegen zu große Länge-Feller vom Zimmerer. Wird zurück abgegeben.
The quality of this attic ladder was exceptional. Easy to install and works like a top! I would recommend this to anyone.
It makes things easier to get to the garage attic.
Exactly what I needed, just make sure to measure the opening in your ceiling!

This is a great ladder and will work for higher ceilings, but do not try to do this on your own. It's heavy enough and you need to and in order to secure it to the beams. This is next to impossible to do by yourself.
